verdict.rationale: Stakeholders get their own dashboard showing all holdings, including convertible notes, shares and transfers, across their AngelList companies. They log in to accept securities, and founders can preview that view, so the self-serve holdings portal is evidenced. However, there is no evidence of structured investor updates or reporting pushed to investors. The update FAQ also says companies are being helped to move to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which raises doubt about the product's continued availability. Missing for 10: a structured investor-update or reporting feature, confirmation the equity product remains offered, and independent hands-on corroboration of the investor portal experience.
